steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (Raimund's acting all shifty...)

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (What is it he can't tell me right now? Something that has to wait until after dark?)

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (I don't get it, but whatever. He can do his own thing.)

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (It's already so late, I'm only now bringing the food over... Seniora Lemuen must be starving by now. And, these portions are tiny.)

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (Be patient, stomach! Stop growling already! Didn't you eat just a minute ago?!)

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (I really hope I can feast one day, just eat all I want without worry.)

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Wh-Who's there?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I know you're here! Who are you?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Who's hiding over there?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Even if you keep quiet, I, I already saw you! You aren't from the abbey!

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Come out! If, if you don't, I'm gonna call the others over– ...I mean, I'm gonna pull the trigger!
Alright, alright. I'm coming out.
Hah, guess I messed up...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: You sure have sharp eyes. Was it the light from my wings? I knew it, it's way too easy to pick out a Sankta, what with everyone having different wings and halos.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Good grief. And here I was thinking I wouldn't need to be all that sneaky.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I've never seen you before. Who are you?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Okay, Seniora. Let's put the gun down first. That isn't something a nice girl should be pointing at her own kind.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: You're a Sankta too. You can feel I don't have anything against you.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I am, uhh... I guess you can call me a justicebringer this time? Yeah, something like that, since I'm here to save people and all.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Fine, if you don't want to talk, I'm going to call for help–

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Woah woah, settle down there.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Mmmmph!!

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (Let go of me!)

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Sure, but you'd better not scream.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: *gasp*... *gasp*...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Sorry, didn't do a good job controlling my strength there. Are you alright?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: *cough*... *cough, cough*... Who exactly are you, and what are you after?!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: It's nothing I can't tell you. I'm looking for someone.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Another Sankta, just like me. Pink hair, probably still in a wheelchair. She's got a kind and gentle look to her, but her personality is actually anything but...

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (Is she talking about Lemuen?!)

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Hmm? That look on your face tells me... you know who I'm talking about? My lucky day.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: The food you just brought over– who's it for? I've got a feeling you're taking it to Lemuen, right?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (Ack?!)

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (How did she know??)

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Haha, looks like I'm right on the money again? You really need to work on your poker face!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: So, would you mind telling me how Seniora Lemuen has been doing?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: You'd prefer not to say, huh? Or are you not allowed to? You're hesitating, and a bit scared...

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: S-Stop it! Stop making things up!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Am I making things up? I guess you'd know.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: You seem to have a lot on your mind, which feels a little odd. How could a cloistered place like this have so much trouble?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Where is all that coming from? Are you getting into fights because there aren't many of your own kind here?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: That's none of your business.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Isn't it? Are you saying that because the patron firearm you're holding hasn't been maintained in a while, because it's rusting?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I don't mind helping you out with that. I'm pretty good at gun repair, so why don't we do a little trade? You just tell me where Lemuen is. That's all.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Why not tell me? I bet you already have an idea of who I am, right? You look pretty smart to me.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Did Laterano send you too, like Seniora Lemuen?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I was.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: That's enough small talk now. I'm a bit short on time.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: You're really not gonna tell me where Lemuen is?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: *sigh*... Well, if that's how it is, that's how it is.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Say...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Let me take care of delivering that food for you.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: *gasp*...!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: That's that, then. Vale.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Last one. That should wrap things up.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: These people are... bandits? They sure know how to make a ruckus.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Federico, how are things on your end? I heard a whole bunch of commotion over there. You didn't blow up any buildings, did you?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I did not.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Great. Well done, I'm just wrapping up over here as well.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Thank you so much. You two are incredible...

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: That should teach the robbers to behave themselves for a while.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: It sounds like this isn't the first time you've been attacked, is it?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: How often does this sort of thing come up?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: If you came from Laterano, you must know how difficult it is to travel these roads.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: If we didn't have a ride, it wouldn't have been able to get here so easily.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Nobody wants to hang around a place like this, except the truly desperate.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: As you saw, there's nothing out here in these barrenlands except this monastery. Once those thugs set their sights on us, do you expect them to give up?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: He's right. Now that it's almost winter, they'll be coming more often.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: That reminds me, didn't Benny hurt his leg last time? How's he doing?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: He's still got a bit of a limp. Only option is to tough it out.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Uh, by the way, who are these two...?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: We're, uhh, I suppose you can call us emissaries from Laterano?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Ah, guests from Laterano... How are you called?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Executor Federico of the Laterano Notarial Hall.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Executor Richele. We have another colleague with us, but she's already one step ahead.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Senior Federico, Senior Richele.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: You don't seemed surprised.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Sure. We knew it was only a matter of time before Laterano sent another. The only question is what kind of guest we would be getting.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: I thought...
The tall, thin, and frail middle-aged man subconsciously glances at the guns in the hands of the two Lateran visitors.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: I thought the next time they sent someone it would be to hand down charges...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Charges? What crimes have you committed?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Under the Notarial Hall's purview, most criminals see a reduced sentence upon surrendering themselves and obtaining the forgiveness of the wronged.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: S-Surrender? Sentence?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Huh? What are you talking about?!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Hold on, Federico! We don't have a handle on the situation yet, let's not worry about that until we find Lemuen and Oren.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Sorry. We'd like to talk to the man in charge here. Do you think you could arrange that for us?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Ah, yes! Give me a second, I'll go...

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Thank you for your assistance. I would be the man you're looking for.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Sorry, I was one step too late.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Your Excellency! And, Gerald...

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Brother Gerald!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Would you be the Most Reverend Abbot of this monastery? And this, uhh, Senior Gerald, is he also a community leader?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: He is not.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Haha. True enough. I am no such important person.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: I realize you must have many questions.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Please, come. Let us find a more suitable place to talk.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Clément, please close the gate, and don't let anyone approach, for the time being.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: But, Your Excellency...

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I'll be here.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Raimund, you keep at it.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Alright. Be careful out there, Brother.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Then, I'll be waiting for you at the door. If you need anything, feel free to call for me.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Alright. Now, no one will disturb us.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: I am the bishop here, Stefano Torregrossa, and I also serve as abbot of this monastery.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: It is a pity that you two came such long way only to find our hospitality so lacking.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: We have no need for meaningless pleasantries.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Under the power vested in us by His Holiness, Pope Yvangelista XI, my colleagues and I came to locate two Lateran nuncios. I ask: Where are Lemuen and Oren Argiolas?

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: I suppose I have no choice but to tell you...

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Seniora Lemuen is currently a guest of our monastery.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: But do not worry. We would never mistreat a guest, and her safety is assured.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: What about Oren Argiolas?

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: The whereabouts of Senior Oren... is actually what I wanted to ask you.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Is it not the case that you arrived so quickly because he contacted the Lateran?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Senior, I'm afraid your statement is inconsistent with our intelligence.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: It is our understanding that Sanctilaminium Ambrosii sent a distress message to Laterano. We dispatched two nuncios in response, and lost contact with both of them.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: And so, His Holiness sent us to find the our people and investigate the situation.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Does any of that conflict with what you know?

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: We were unable to retain Senior Oren.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: By that you mean you weren't able to keep Oren restrained.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: You can say that again. He was on edge the whole time.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: While 'inviting' Seniora Lemuen to remain our guest, he took advantage of the distraction and slipped out.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: We don't know what happened to him after that.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Federico.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Oren escaped, but hasn't shown himself or contacted us.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Does that ring any alarm bells for you?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: You could add a little more than just 'yes.'

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: And, my becloaked friend, I can't imagine any of the ordinary residents here would be quite so in-the-know. Who exactly are you?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Think of me as the hunter here, or maybe a bodyguard. No need to worry about me.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Alright then. Uhh, we'll just run with that for now...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Set Oren aside for now. We demand a reasonable explanation for Seniora Lemuen's circumstances.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Why would a monastery need to restrict the movements of a Lateran nuncio who came to offer aid? Your answer will determine our subsequent actions.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Considering you are both Lateran emissaries, you should already be familiar with this monastery's history.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Our knowledge is limited to the information in the mission briefing.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Over a decade ago... We entered the wastes to avoid a Catastrophe, ran out of fuel, and the monastery has been trapped here ever since.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Unable to communicate with the outside world, all we could do was try to farm for ourselves. But, the soil in these parts is mostly fallow, and not much food grows these days.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: That's not all. The beasts that wander the barrens, and robbers even more vicious than beasts, all pose grave threats.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: We never had much choice...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: So you decided to take in vagrants wandering the wastes.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: 'Take in' is far too generous a term. No, we did no such act of charity.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: We were merely accepting people who had no home to return to. There are many reasons a person can become uprooted, and we did nothing more than offer them a new place to stay.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Stefano...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: A point of clarification.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: There's one thing I'd like to ascertain.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Woah, Federico, what are do...?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Hey! Don't!

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Reverend Executor! This is most unusual!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I'm finished.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: You really just went for it...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: But, this definitely something. Your Excellency, can I ask you to explain what's going on here?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: In the heart of a Lateran monastery–

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Why have we found a Sarkaz?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Well, I guess that's that...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I apologize if you find this offensive.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: But what are you doing here?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I already told you. I'm just a hunter. Gerald, the hunter.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Unfortunately... It doesn't look like you believe me.
